messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm scheduling migration MIG-4521 to add user_profiles.last_seen at 23:00 UTC tonight. Backfill will run in small batches (5k). Holdpoint at 23:15 for canary verification. Tagging @deploy-bot @db-eng @sre-oncall. Please ack if you have blocking items.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Migration MIG-4521 created. Start: 2024-05-06 23:00:00 UTC. Holdpoint: 2024-05-06 23:15:00 UTC. Run `deploybot start MIG-4521` to kick off, or `deploybot rollback MIG-4521` to abort.

maria: ack — I'll run the canary smoke tests and validation queries at the holdpoint.

sam: noted. backfill estimate ~18m with concurrency 8, batch_size=5k. I'll throttled on CPU/lock pressure. If max_lock_wait > 30s we'll abort batch.

db-eng: adding an advisory lock to the migration to ensure single orchestrator across regions. Script snippet:```sql
BEGIN;
SELECT pg_advisory_lock(987654321);
ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD COLUMN last_seen timestamptz;
-- backfill in batches using id range, sleep on contention
COMMIT;
```

sre-oncall: reminder: pin API services to schema v1 for the window. Please set feature flag `last_seen_enabled=false` before start and flip after final validation. Also, pre-create a maintenance alert for >5% error increase.

maria: I will pin api-service v1.12.3 and add a read-only canary with header `x-canary:1`. Running the validation queries locally now.

alex: Rollback plan (short): 1) at deploybot level: `deploybot rollback MIG-4521` — this will stop ongoing backfills and revert any non-destructive state. 2) emergency DB-level: `ALTER TABLE user_profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_seen;` only if safe and after coordination. 3) restore read replica snapshot if corruption detected.

sam: escalation criteria: abort backfill and hit holdpoint if any of: lock wait >30s, replication lag >1m, 5xx rate up by >3x. Eng-oncall paged if abort required.

deploy-bot: holdpoint reached at 2024-05-06 23:15:00 UTC. Canary results: 2/2 canary hosts returned expected rows, P95 latency unchanged (+2ms), no errors. React :thumbsup: to continue, :x: to abort.

alex: :thumbsup: proceeding to continue backfill.

maria: canary smoke queries below — will rerun after final chunk:
`SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_profiles WHERE last_seen IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;`
`SELECT last_seen FROM user_profiles WHERE id IN (12345, 54321);`

db-eng: running batched backfill with per-batch advisory timeouts. If any batch hits the timeout we will rollback that batch and pause. Logging to /var/log/migrations/MIG-4521.log

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards up: QPS, P95 latency, replication lag, lock_counter. I'll escalate on anomalies.

deploy-bot: MIG-4521 completed at 2024-05-06 23:40:15 UTC. Backfilled rows: 1,237,450. Errors: 0. No rollback executed.

alex: Thanks everyone. Follow-up action: open a short postmortem doc if any alerts triggered (none expected). Unpin api-service and flip feature flag `last_seen_enabled=true` in 30m if no regression.

maria: will flip flag and unpin after 30m quiet window. Logging the final canary snapshots to the release notes.

sam: leaving a small script in infra repo to resume/rollback which includes safe abort path and metrics scrape.

db-eng: closing migration ticket and marking MIG-4521 as successful.
